overall.current_focus: Prepare a read-only Notion internal integration, then implement a live API collector that generates the companion snapshot used with the ZIP export.

completed.summary: Confirmed that no mature direct Notion-to-Loop migration product or open-source project was found.
Verified that documented Loop external integrations cover GitHub, Jira, and Trello, not Notion.
Verified the absence of a documented public Loop page content mutation API and identified the separate management API announcement.
Analyzed Notion export fidelity and established that the API and exports must be combined for complex migration.
Evaluated Loop Copilot as an execution surface and found that it can assist transformation but cannot autonomously update a page or workspace.
Created a shared Claude/GPT project memory structure and recorded research, decisions, progress, and backlog.
Recorded feature-first DDD as the accepted code organization convention for all agents.
Finalized the phased execution plan and created a reproducible project-local Micromamba environment with Node.js 24, locked npm dependencies, strict TypeScript, and Vitest.

Implemented the representative Notion fixture, canonical graph ingestion for directories and ZIPs, deterministic compatibility analysis, provider-neutral agent tasks, sanitized Loop-ready HTML, and the visual Migration Studio dashboard.

Hardened source ingestion and package generation against path traversal, oversized archives, stale generated pages, and static-server path escapes; regenerated the demo and passed all 9 tests, type-checking, and build.
Started the built Migration Studio as an independent localhost process and verified successful GET and HEAD responses on port 4173.

Confirmed from official Notion documentation that a read-only internal integration can access connected pages, databases, property schemas, and relation IDs when all related content is shared with it.

Migrated the allowlisted offline prototype into the Git-backed target repository, documented its safety boundaries, and verified the Node.js 24 type-check, tests, build, demo, and staged-data security checks.

blockers.summary: No documented public API currently provides deterministic native Loop page and block creation.
blockers.resolution_path: Confirm internal Loop APIs or prove a supported guided insertion adapter.

blockers.summary: The default target mapping for complex databases has not been chosen.
blockers.resolution_path: Compare Loop tables, Microsoft Lists, Planner, and Adaptive Card-based components against sample schemas.

blockers.summary: A live Notion integration and connected test workspace have not yet been configured.
blockers.resolution_path: Create an internal integration with Read content capability, connect the migration root page and related databases, and store the token only in local secret configuration.

next_steps: Create a Notion internal integration with Read content capability.
Connect the representative workspace root page and every related database to the integration.
Store the Notion token in a local ignored environment file and identify the migration root page ID; never place the token in chat or project memory.
Implement the live Notion API collector and emit the existing companion snapshot schema.
Run the combined API plus ZIP ingestion before continuing with Microsoft 365 target execution and second-pass relation resolution.

history.event: Initialized cross-model project memory from the discovery conversation.
Accepted feature-first DDD with per-feature domain, application, infrastructure, and presentation layers.
Completed execution planning and verified the portable Micromamba TypeScript environment with type-checking, tests, and build.

Added bounded source ingestion, safe generated filenames, clean package regeneration, and resolved-root static serving; all 9 tests, type-checking, and build passed.
Verified the generated Migration Studio over localhost at port 4173 using the built application.
Confirmed the Notion internal integration path and recorded the exact user setup and live collector implementation handoff.
Replaced the target repository working tree through an allowlisted migration, kept generated output ignored, and validated the offline prototype and staged content.
